nodes.label: DESIGN.md Frontmatter Token Schema

nodes.label: Scan Mode vs Seed Mode
nodes.rationale: Scan extracts incumbent system when tokens exist; seed workshops a new world when no code exists. Deciding by scan avoids overwriting coherent identity with invented tokens

nodes.label: Design Detector Hook Two Tiers

nodes.label: BuildPath Workflow Comp vs Code

nodes.label: PRODUCT.md Product Truth

nodes.label: iOS Slop Test

nodes.label: Propose Before Building Overdrive
nodes.rationale: Highest misfire potential; proposing 2-3 directions with trade-offs before code avoids building embarrassing effect that must be thrown away

nodes.label: Type System and Roles
nodes.rationale: Fewest roles that make hierarchy unmistakable; combine size weight space tone not size alone; role names describe purpose not values

nodes.label: Adaptation Strategy
nodes.rationale: Adaptation is rethinking experience for new context not scaling pixels; must reassess source assumptions device input constraints and usage context before planning layout interaction content navigation

nodes.label: Material Design 3
nodes.rationale: Material 3 governs structure navigation interaction; brand expresses via theming color roles type scale shape motion; color roles resolve light dark contrast automatically raw hex breaks

nodes.label: Motion Thesis
nodes.rationale: Define focal moment continuity feedback budget before implementation; one rehearsed focal sequence beats scattered reveals; choose material by meaning transform opacity blur clip-path shader per communication goal

nodes.label: Bolder Amplification
nodes.rationale: Scope is sovereign touch only named target; amplify what system already owns at full strength turn up not invent; skeleton test without copy must still communicate hierarchy via system devices

nodes.label: Delight Thesis
nodes.rationale: Delight is product character at earned moments not generic whimsy; match response to effort and consequence; protect by not delaying blocking or overriding platform accessibility; variation useful only if coherent on 100th use

nodes.label: Distill Simplification
nodes.rationale: Perfection when nothing left to take away; identify complexity sources variation overload visual noise; apply progressive disclosure consolidation ruthless editing preserving necessary functionality and accessibility

nodes.label: Impeccable Skill
nodes.rationale: Award-winning design director POV: go all out with production-grade craft and peak creativity; verify in bounded passes sharing one render for screenshots defects micro-edits and rebuilds to avoid open-ended self-QA burning money worse than finish handoffs
